# Release Notes - v1.4.0

## Security, Observability & Architecture Overhaul

This release introduces the **Security Scan Report dashboard**, a **live Running Apps view**, **per-container PostgreSQL credentials**, and migrates all remote operations from SSH to the **Docker Engine API over mutual TLS (mTLS)**.

### 🛡️ Security Scan Report Dashboard
- **CI/CD scan aggregation**: Polls Trivy, OWASP ZAP, and SonarQube reports from a Sonatype Nexus raw repo
- **Severity matrix**: Critical / High / Medium / Low counts surfaced at a glance with brand-tinted stat tiles
- **Tabbed details**: Container & Dependencies (vulnerabilities + SBOM), Code Quality (Sonar metrics), Live Runtime API (ZAP alerts)
- **Environment dropdown**: Switch between `repo / branch` targets to compare main vs UAT scans side-by-side
- **Defensive parser**: Malformed reports return a `status:"unsupported"` payload instead of crashing the request
- **Source management**: Admins can add, edit (no more delete-and-recreate to fix a typo), refresh-on-demand, and delete scan sources

### 🚀 Running Apps Tab
- **Live Docker Compose view**: Lists every running compose project per server, grouped by `/root/<group>` working-dir prefix
- **Frontend URL resolution**: On-host helper agent reads `nginx.conf` to map published ports back to domain URLs; falls back to `ip:port` when the agent is missing
- **Copy-paste agent deploy**: A one-liner deployment command is surfaced inline whenever the helper agent isn't detected on a server
- **Admin pin feature**: Pin a root-group (e.g. `qms`, `ebmr`) so it floats to the top of the cards for every viewer — audit-logged, idempotent, globally visible
- **Theme-aware folder cards**: Orange/blue palette in light mode, dark-glossy red/blue gradient with a wet-sheen overlay in dark mode
- **Drill-in view**: Sage-canvas container cards in a 5-column grid (Frontends always expanded; Services collapsed by default)

### 🔐 PostgreSQL Credential Management
- **Per-container encrypted credentials**: For hardened images that removed the default `postgres` role
- **Admin-configurable**: Set DB user, maintenance DB, and password via a UI dialog; passwords stored encrypted via `ENCRYPTION_KEY`
- **Sidebar indicator**: A small key icon appears next to containers with custom credentials
- **Streaming pg_dump downloads**: Real-time progress percentage computed from `db.size` estimate when the response is chunked; bigger black Download button with status-driven progress bar

### 🌐 mTLS Architecture Migration
- **SSH retired**: Backend now talks to managed hosts exclusively via Docker Engine API on port 2376 over mutual TLS
- **Per-server credentials**: CA cert + client cert + encrypted client key stored per server
- **Database migration**: Legacy SSH columns dropped via migration `003_drop_ssh_columns`
- **Connectivity tests**: New endpoint `POST /api/servers/:id/test` verifies the Docker API handshake before saving

### 🎨 UI Refinements
- **`PillTag` primitive**: New shared component with 8 tones × 2 sizes, adopted by `StatusBadge`, audit-log action/resource chips, user role badges, container project tags, and URL domain indicators — single edit point for all label styling
- **Editorial serif headings**: Newsreader restored on `h1`/`h2`/`.font-display` for brand consistency (had been switched to sans by an earlier WealthSync experiment)
- **Server picker redesigned**: Two-panel "weather widget" layout with a status-tinted accent panel (server name + address) next to a dark stats strip showing live container / compose-file / project counts per server
- **Database Dump sidebar**: Health dots + concise uptime labels (e.g. `≈1 min`, `24 min`, `3 hr`, `2 d`) replace Docker's verbose `Up X minutes (healthy)`
- **Theme-aware throughout**: New `useTheme` hook lets inline-styled components (folder cards, sage container cards) swap palettes by watching the `.dark` class on `<html>`

### 🧱 Backend Additions

**New routes**

```
auth.GET    /api/scan-reports
auth.GET    /api/scan-reports/:id
auth.GET    /api/scan-reports/:id/parsed
admin.POST  /api/scan-reports
admin.PUT   /api/scan-reports/:id
admin.POST  /api/scan-reports/:id/refresh
admin.DELETE /api/scan-reports/:id

auth.GET     /api/servers/:id/running-apps
admin.PUT    /api/servers/:id/running-apps/:group/pin
admin.DELETE /api/servers/:id/running-apps/:group/pin

auth.GET     /api/servers/:id/postgres/credentials
admin.PUT    /api/servers/:id/postgres/credentials
admin.DELETE /api/servers/:id/postgres/credentials/:container_name
```

**New tables (AutoMigrated on boot)**
- `scan_reports` — registered scan sources + latest fetched JSON
- `pinned_projects` — admin pins for Running Apps, keyed by `(server_id, group_name)`
- `postgres_credentials` — per-container DB credentials with encrypted password column

**New env vars (optional)**
- `NEXUS_URL`, `NEXUS_USER`, `NEXUS_PASS` — when unset, the scan poller stays idle
- `ENCRYPTION_KEY` — required for encrypting/decrypting PostgreSQL passwords and mTLS client keys

**Scan parser library** ([backend/services/scan_parser.go](../backend/services/scan_parser.go))
- Trivy: vulnerabilities + SBOM components, severity normalized to CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW
- ZAP: alerts grouped by risk (High/Medium/Low/Informational) with instance counts
- Sonar: text key/value metric extraction (bugs, vulnerabilities, code smells, hotspots, etc.)

**New React hooks**
- `useTheme` — watches `.dark` class on `<html>` via MutationObserver
- `useServerStats` — aggregates per-server container/compose/project counts in parallel
- `useRunningApps` — list + pin/unpin
- `useScanReports` — list / get / parsed / add / update / refresh / delete

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes
- **SSH columns dropped from `servers` table**. Existing servers must be re-registered with mTLS credentials (CA cert + client cert + client key)
- **Default JWT session length**: Reduced to 1 day (from 7) for tighter security
- **`/api/scan-reports/*` and `/api/servers/:id/running-apps` are new endpoints** — any external clients depending on previous routes are unaffected

## Migration Notes
1. **Re-register servers** through Config → Infrastructure with mTLS credentials (no automatic migration path from SSH).
2. **Deploy the helper agent** on each managed host for domain URL resolution in Running Apps. The one-line command is surfaced inline in the UI when the agent is missing:
   ```bash
   docker run -d --name webmanager-agent --restart unless-stopped \
     --label webmanager.agent=true \
     -v /etc/nginx/conf.d:/etc/nginx/conf.d:ro \
     alpine:3 sleep infinity
   ```
3. **Set `ENCRYPTION_KEY`** in production env to a stable 32-byte secret. Rotating it without re-encrypting stored secrets will brick existing server credentials, PostgreSQL credentials, and any stored Nexus passwords.
4. **Optional**: Set `NEXUS_URL`, `NEXUS_USER`, `NEXUS_PASS` to enable the background scan poller (every 5 minutes by default; manual refresh always available via the UI button).

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed misleading status text on container sidebar — health is now parsed from Docker's verbose status string into a clean dot + concise duration
- Fixed `pg_dump` downloads showing an indeterminate spinner — now displays a real percentage from the moment the first chunk arrives
- Resolved typography regression where editorial `h1`/`h2` headings rendered in sans-serif Inter instead of the brand serif (Newsreader)

## Performance & Architecture
- **Direct Docker Engine API** access replaces SSH-tunnel + CLI shell-out — single round-trip per operation, no process spawning
- **Parsing decoupled from storage**: Scan reports store raw JSON; the new `/parsed` endpoint computes the structured DTO on demand
- **Streaming pg_dump**: Uses `response.body.getReader()` instead of buffering with `response.blob()` — large dumps no longer block the UI thread waiting for the full payload

---

This release represents the largest single bump since v1.0 — turning WebManager into a unified DevOps + Security observability surface across Docker Compose runtime, PostgreSQL state, and CI/CD compliance scans.
